sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence .

It is further submitted that petitioner was posted as Junior Engineer, Irrigation Division Tarapur, Kharagpur from 04.08.2009 to 30.11.2013 and the alleged supply of bogus boulders and pitching was done from 09.01.2009 to 18.01.2009.
Petitioner joined much after the aforesaid incident.
Petitioner was not involved in the supply of boulder or ptiching of boulders.
Chargesheet has already been submitted.
Similarly situated co- accused persons have already granted bail by this Court vide order dated 27.02.2023 in Cr. Misc. No. 5106 of 2023 .
Petitioner claims clean antecedent.
5 . Learned counsel for the State as well as vigilance opposed the bail petition of the petitioner.

6. Considering the fact that similarly situated co- accused have already been granted bail, clean antecedent of the petitioner and circumstances of the case , in the event of arrest or surrender within eight weeks from today, let the petitioner, as named above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/-(ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.32893 of 2024(3) dt.13-09-2024 each to the satisfaction of the learned Special Judge Vigilance ( Trap) Bhagalpur in connection with Patna Vigilance P.S. case No. 048 of 2015 , subject to the conditions laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure with following conditions:
"(i) Petitioner shall co-operate in the trial and shall be properly represented on each and every date fixed by the court blew and shall remain physically present, as directed by the Court below and on his absence on two consecutive date without sufficient reason , his bail-bond shall be cancelled by the Court below .
